system.description: An elder owes you prestation for a favor performed by you or your sire, and Cainite custom gives him no easy way out of the debt without repaying you. One Trait indicates a minor boon, two Traits a major boon, and three Traits a blood boon. Work with your Storyteller to define the circumstances of the debt.
system.source: Laws of the Night Revised, Character Creation and Traits
